out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shelled eggs stored above RTE housemade sauces inside WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated raw shelled eggs on shelf below RTE housemade saucess

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: cooked to order burgers and lamb on the cocktail/ happy hours menu.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. CDI: CFM was able to reprint cocktail/ happy hours menu to include disclosure statement and reminder next to the cooked to order lamb or burgers onsite at time of inspection.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold equipment: multiple cold hold units throughout the main kitchen area without digital thermometer. True 2 Dr flattop refrigerator (bar area) True 2 Dr preptop refrigerator (main kitchen) and 4 DWR undergrill refrigerator (mani kitchen).
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM stated he would place ambient thermometer in all cold hold units without digital thermometer reading.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed two ice bins that have been cleaned not stored covered or inverted on shelf next to ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. CDI: CFM washed, rinsed, and sanitized ice buckets and inverted on top of clean food contact surface.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: temperature gauges for wash and final rinse cycle on high temperature dish machine in the main kitchen area. High temperature dish machine internal temperature tested with color coded test strips.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EHS instructed CFM to schedule repair on wash and final rinse temperature gauge on high temperature dish machine in the main kitchen area.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: EHS will email CFM copy of employee health policy to review information with staff, sign, and maintain in file for future reference.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink in dish washing area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: CFM placed paper towels at hand sink.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Observed debris on the interior of ice machine and ice scoop holder in main kitchen and not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. EHS instructed CFM to clean ice machine and ice scoop holder frequently to prevent accumulation of debris on the interior.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: whole milk (45F) stored in overfilled reach in cooler in bar area (glass bottles of water) limiting cold air flow throughout the unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM relocated milk to another reach in cooler that will allow propel cold hold of at least 41F or below.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Variance Requirement, ROP (2 or more barriers)
violations.observation: The person in charge described a method of packaging the following food using Reduced Oxygen Packaging requiring a variance from the Health Department: vacuum packaging cooked meats and holding for 4 days without approved HACCP plan from the health department.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall obtain a variance from the Regulatory Authority as specified in 8-103.10 and under 8-103.11 before: 1) smoking food as a method of food preservation rather than as a method for flavor enhancement, 2) curing food, 3) using food additives or adding components such as vinegar, 4) packaging food using a Reduced Oxygen Packaging method, 5) operating a molluscan shellfish life-support system display tank used to store and display shellfish that are offered for human consumption, 6) custom processing animals that are for personal use as food and not for sale or service in a food establishment, 7) preparing food by another method that is determined by the Regulatory Authority to require a variance, or 8) sprouting seeds or beans. CDI: CFM agreed to hold cooked vacuum packaged meats for no more than 48 hours maximum and will date and time stamp packages.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Observed 2 big plastic container of hot peppers stored uncovered directly in front of hand sink at end of grill line where it is subject to splash.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. CDI: CFM relocated and covered the red peppers until prepped.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: Observed no heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine in the main kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. CDI: CFM order high temp thermometer during inspection.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: Observed cook using barehand to put RTE garnish (fried onions and veggies) on top of meatballs about to be served to customer.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. CFM discarded dish. EHS educated cook on using gloves or utensils to garnish RTE food items.

Raw ground beef stored over onions in 1DR True UR.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: Observed whipped cream prepared on 5/24/25 inside of 1 dr upright cooler near WIC. Observed pickled rhubarb prepared on 5/27/2025.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CFM instructed staff to discard whipped cream and pickled rhubarb.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without a reminder statement: Observed the following items offered as raw or uncooked on menu without consumer advisory asterisk next to food items: Smoked trout roe, burgers, fried and poached eggs.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions'. CFM will add asterisk to menu for all food items that are offered raw or undercooked. Please submit corrected menu to the Health Department by 6/13/2025.

violations.title: Variance Requirement, ROP (2 or more barriers)
violations.observation: The person in charge described a method of packaging the following food using Reduced Oxygen Packaging requiring a variance from the Health Department: Observed sous vide lamb and duck inside of WIC and 1 dr upright cooler kept longer 7 days.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall obtain a variance from the Regulatory Authority as specified in 8-103.10 and under 8-103.11 before: 1) smoking food as a method of food preservation rather than as a method for flavor enhancement, 2) curing food, 3) using food additives or adding components such as vinegar, 4) packaging food using a Reduced Oxygen Packaging method, 5) operating a molluscan shellfish life-support system display tank used to store and display shellfish that are offered for human consumption, 6) custom processing animals that are for personal use as food and not for sale or service in a food establishment, 7) preparing food by another method that is determined by the Regulatory Authority to require a variance, or 8) sprouting seeds or beans. out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing watches on their arms and hands while preparing food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. EHS educated on not wearing watches while preparing food.

violations.observation: The following equipment is in poor repair: Walk in freezer (downstairs) ceiling peeling.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EHS advised CFM to repair peeling ceiling of walk in freezer downstairs.

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: Observed no high temperature thermometer or heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, and drinking in the kitchen, in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the two of the washing hand-sinks at the bar were being used for storage.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Maintain all hand washing sinks empty, properly supplies with soap and paper towels, and easily accessible at any time for hand washing.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: Some sauces were observed held beyond 7 days.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food.Food handlers were observed wearing watches and bracelets in the food prearation areas.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. Some food handlers were observed in the kitchen without wearing proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: The refrigerated prep table’s top display unit are not maintain foods at 41F or lower.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Repair this unit accordingly to ensure proper food temperatures are being maintained.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): Milk crates are being used as racks to stare supplies above the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. Replace the milk crates with dunnage racks or anther shelving as listed above.
